<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Board is reset. Let me try moving cross 1 first, then cross 2
# Cross 1 at (19, 18) → target at (19, 30) [row 1, col 3]
# Cross 2 at (19, 24) → target at (19, 12) [row 1, col 0]

# Step 1: Click cross 1
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 19, 'col': 18}])

# Verify charcoal target
seg = current_frame.segmentation
g_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'g']
target_pos = None
for gn in g_nodes:
    boundary = gn['boundary']
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
    if target_pos is None or min_r < target_pos[0]:
        target_pos = (min_r, min_c)
print(f"Cross 1 target: {target_pos}")

# Step 2: Click the target to move cross 1
if target_pos:
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': target_pos[0]+1, 'col': target_pos[1]+2}])
    
    # Check state
    N_nodes = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"After moving cross 1: {len(N_nodes)} green crosses")
    for nn in N_nodes:
        boundary = nn['boundary']
        min_r = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
        min_c = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
        print(f"  at ({min_r},{min_c})")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
